source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Load AMDGPU RAS, establish a zero UMC error-count baseline, execute one amdgpuras device-0/block-0 injection, and verify tool success, a hardware-error log and a non-zero post-injection UMC count.
procedure_facts: Query `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -q 1` and expect zero before injection.
The prose describes this as an ODECC correctable injection at address 0x800.
criteria_facts: dmesg shows an amdgpu hardware error.
A repeated UMC query reports a non-zero count.
source_conflicts: The item is `UMC Replay AC Parity`, while the Procedure calls the operation `ODECC correctable error`; the row does not prove these are the same error subtype.
The prose says address 0x800, but the displayed command contains no explicit address argument and the private flag meanings are undocumented in the row.
The linked script name ends in `_oob`, while the shown host-side amdgpuras sequence is described by V2 as in-band.
missing_source_information: Exact amdgpuras build/hash and meanings of `-d/-b/-s/-t/-m/-q` for this GPU/tool version.
Authoritative mapping between Replay AC Parity, ODECC correctable, address 0x800 and the command.
Stable GPU index-to-UUID/BDF/serial mapping and UMC instance/mask coverage.
Expected event fields, exact counter delta, timeout, no-reset/health behavior and recovery.

original_test_intent.statement: Validate one AMD GPU UMC Replay AC Parity correctable-error path on the approved GPU/UMC target by proving the exact intended stimulus, a fresh target-correlated correctable event and a UMC counter increase without unintended reset or loss of GPU health; the source's ODECC/address/command mismatch must be resolved first.
must_preserve: UMC Replay AC Parity as the item-defined error subtype unless the owner corrects the source.
One approved AMD GPU/UMC target rather than host DDR or another GPU block.
Tool-success, native hardware-error evidence and before/after UMC count gates.
must_not_infer: That Replay AC Parity and ODECC correctable are synonyms.
That the shown flags encode address 0x800 or the named subtype.
That device index 0 is the same physical GPU across boots or tools.
That any non-zero historical UMC count or generic dmesg line proves this run.
That a correctable UMC test may reset the GPU/host or degrade HBM without an explicit platform rule.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly rejects BLOCKED based only on a missing package, gates the real hardware injection on tool/target/flag confirmation and requires tool, dmesg and counter evidence on a dedicated SUT.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 accepts the displayed command as a coherent UMC Replay AC Parity test without identifying the source's Replay-AC-Parity versus ODECC conflict, the missing explicit 0x800 address, the `_oob` script-name mismatch or the need for a fresh counter delta rather than merely non-zero post-state.

related_records: Other AMD GPU ODECC, UMC replay and OOB cases are separate variants and cannot resolve this row's private flag mapping by analogy.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The item name is the primary intent anchor; contradictory Procedure prose and undocumented tool flags are marked SOURCE_CONFLICT rather than silently relabeling the test.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep the gated hybrid capability, but prohibit injection until the owner proves or corrects the Replay AC Parity/ODECC/address/flag relationship and execution location. Require stable GPU identity plus a fresh event and counter delta, not generic output or non-zero historical state.

conditions_present: Tool family, one command, nominal device/block, baseline query, three broad acceptance observations and planning times are present.
missing: Resolved error subtype and address semantics, exact tool build/flags, in-band versus OOB path, stable target/UMC mapping, event signature, counter delta, timeout, approvals and recovery.
provider: AMD/ODM FAE supplies the amdgpuras flag map and authoritative UMC Replay AC Parity recipe.
GPU owner maps device/block/mask/address to GPU UUID/BDF/serial and UMC instance.
Test/lab owner selects execution path, expected evidence/timeout and authorizes the dedicated SUT/recovery.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory all AMD GPUs by UUID/BDF/serial, driver/firmware/kernel and supported RAS blocks/features.
Capture `amdgpuras` version/help/capability and resolve device indices without injecting.
Record timestamped dmesg, BMC/firmware logs, GPU health and per-target UMC counters without clearing them.
prohibited_until_resolved: Driver load/unload/rebind or module-parameter change, log/counter clear, amdgpuras stimulus, OOB action, reset/reboot, retry or PASS/FAIL claim.
closure_evidence: Signed tool documentation binds all flags and any address to the exact Replay AC Parity correctable subtype, or the source item/procedure is corrected.
The `_oob` script reference and shown host command are reconciled to one approved execution path.
GPU/UMC target, fresh event/counter-delta rule, timeout, no-reset/health gate and recovery are approved.

revision_candidate.test_name: AMD GPU UMC Replay AC Parity Correctable Injection
revision_candidate.purpose: Inject one owner-defined UMC Replay AC Parity correctable error into the approved AMD GPU/UMC target and verify exact tool success, a fresh target-correlated native event, the prescribed UMC counter delta and preserved GPU/HBM/system health.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Only the AMD GPU ASIC/firmware, host OS/kernel, AMDGPU driver and amdgpuras build for which the signed recipe maps Replay AC Parity to the exact command, address and execution path. Do not transfer ODECC, OOB or another GPU generation's flags.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Exactly the owner-approved GPU UUID/BDF/serial and UMC block/instance/mask resolved from the tool's current enumeration. Device index 0 and block 0 are accepted only after mapping. Address 0x800 is used only if the signed tool semantics explicitly require it. One injection unless the corrected source defines more. Treat 30/15 minutes as estimates.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Exact amdgpuras build/hash/help and signed meanings of device, block, query, subtype/type, mask and address fields; corrected Replay AC Parity versus ODECC definition; reconciled in-band/OOB execution path; GPU UUID/BDF/serial-to-tool-index and UMC mapping; compatible firmware/driver/kernel and RAS features; baseline and expected counter delta; native event identity/severity/freshness/timeout; no-reset/HBM/GPU health criteria; approvals; evidence storage; recovery/restoration.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture GPU identities, tool/driver/firmware versions, supported RAS features, full native/BMC baselines and the target UMC counter. If the source requires a zero baseline and it is already non-zero, stop unless a signed non-destructive freshness/delta method is provided. After explicit approval and only after flag semantics resolve the source conflict, apply `ras_enable=1` through the signed loaded-driver method, re-enumerate the target, run exactly one corrected amdgpuras Replay AC Parity command, capture full output, then collect a fresh native event and UMC counter delta for that GPU. Restore or hand off state per recipe; do not substitute ODECC or OOB commands.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Source conflict resolved; exact tool/target/command/path approved; dedicated idle non-production SUT; stable GPU/HBM, power and thermal baseline; console/OOB, evidence storage and recovery proven; module-state, baseline freshness and final-state plans signed; every driver change, clear, injection, reset and restoration authorized.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: GPU UUID/BDF/serial, ASIC/firmware/driver/kernel/tool identities and hashes; signed flag/error/address/path mapping; current tool index and UMC target; module parameters and RAS features; baseline audit and pre-count; exact injection command/transcript with expected success; timestamped target-correlated Replay AC Parity correctable native event within timeout; prescribed UMC counter delta from the recorded baseline; conditional BMC/OOB evidence if the selected path requires it; no unexpected reset, HBM loss or GPU degradation; anomalies, recovery, restoration/handoff and engineer disposition.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The corrected and signed AMD/ODM UMC Replay AC Parity recipe for the exact GPU and amdgpuras build. Tool success, a generic amdgpu message or non-zero counter alone is insufficient; the intended subtype, target, fresh event, counter delta and health gates must all agree.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not equate Replay AC Parity with ODECC, invent address semantics, use device index 0 without stable mapping, mix in-band and OOB paths, count historical errors, clear counters without an approved audit, load/unload an active driver, inject on production, auto-loop/retry, accept reset/degradation as correctable behavior or claim PASS from tool success. Stop on wrong target/type/severity/path, missing event/delta, reset, GPU/HBM loss, XGMI/PCIe degradation, thermal/power anomaly or persistent error.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: AMD/ODM FAE approves subtype, flags, address and path; GPU owner approves UUID/BDF/serial/UMC mapping and expected RAS behavior; lab owner approves dedicated SUT, driver state and recovery. Each injection and any reset/retry require recorded approval; engineer owns final disposition.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Qualified staff own source correction, package provenance, driver-state changes, target confirmation, injection authorization and exceptional recovery. After exact handoff, an Agent may run one bounded approved command and correlate read-only evidence; it may not change subtype/path/target or decide that a generic counter proves PASS.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On wrong subtype/target/path, tool failure, missing/ambiguous event or delta, reset, GPU/HBM degradation or persistent fault, stop and preserve complete evidence. Use the signed AMD GPU/driver recovery, restore module and injection state, prove GPU/HBM/PCIe/system health and obtain a fresh approval before any rerun.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Replay AC Parity/ODECC/address or in-band/OOB conflict unresolved; tool flags, GPU/UMC mapping, baseline freshness, event signature, timeout, approval or recovery missing; pre-count violates the signed baseline rule; command/help differs; wrong target/type/severity; no tool success, native event or required delta; unexpected reset, GPU/HBM/link loss, thermal/power anomaly, persistent error; or failed recovery/restoration/final health.

identified_defects: Item and Procedure disagree between Replay AC Parity and ODECC correctable.
The stated address 0x800 is not explicit in the shown command and flags are undocumented.
The linked script name implies OOB while the command is host-side/in-band.
Device index 0 is not a stable physical identity.
A non-zero post-count can be stale and needs a fresh delta.
V2 accepts generic dmesg rather than a subtype- and target-correlated event.
reason_for_change: Prevent a concrete-looking private-tool command from hiding three source inconsistencies, and require proof that the intended Replay AC Parity subtype—not ODECC or an OOB variant—caused a fresh target-specific event and counter delta.
